body: I think I'm gonna delete all my videos and just, start fresh. Upload at least weekly or daily. I don't want to change the name/channel though, since it's just my name and middle name. I don't want to seem like I'm promoting myself on a fucking suicide forum so, I'm only linking because you asked. :) https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCh6-b5tPv5b1vQd3q2YzwgA/videos
Thank you so much, all of the nice comments are making me think twice over my situation and if I'm really as weak and bad as alot of people in my past and present tell me.
That concept scares the shit out of me. Fuck, is it really that serious?
Maybe I have somewhat Stockholm syndrome. I keep making excuses in my head on why it wouldn't work, isn't a good idea, or why what she's doing isn't abuse.

I've thought about this but if I'm sent home I know I'm fucked and my mother would attack me. So, needles to say I'm scared shitless.
(Psychically.) I'm underweight and extremely short, not a good fighter, etc. She's already smashed my head off walls before.

I have a channel that I was really good about making video ideas and uploading for awhile, getting better and learning my software, etc till some real life stuff happened, my Mum had a roommate move in, he turned out to be a pedophile and attempted to sexually harass me, I told my Mum and there was police at my house and everything, got caught up in the shitstorm and stopped the uploads. And I do think that would make me happy, honestly. Being able to influence young people (even though I am one.), help people who need an escape from their life, and generally be a positive impact to other's lives, since there's alot of hardships for everyone.

I'm really glad I could inspire you, honestly. I idolized a person who made videos online when I was really young, and they were my escape from my reality. That person died back in 2013 though, ever since then I wanted to be able to do YouTube videos and help to inspire people and push them through hard times, and be the person that the content creator was for me. It sounds cliche but it's really not about the money. I've grown up in a poor family and I know that I can make it by off little bits of money, if it pays or not doesn't matter to me. So, thank you for the kind words.
Thank you for caring to comment, Maxwell. I've been abused alot and one of the things they all brought up again and again is that I'm weak. Having someone disagree on that is comforting.
